newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan sells July 2-19 diesel at $22.50-$23.00/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan sells July 2-19 diesel at $22.50-$23.00/bbl.

text.p: Taiwan's Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded its tender to sell 225,000-250,000 barrels of 0.3-percent sulphur diesel for July 2-19 delivery at $22.50-$23.00 a barrel, a CPC official said on Wednesday.
"We sold up to two cargoes of diesel free-on-board Kaohsiung basis," the official said.
The tender closed June 9 and offers were valid for two days.
In its last tender, Taiwan sold two 225,000 to 250,000 barrel cargoes of diesel for June 4-17 lifting at around $24.60 a barrel, fob Kaohsiung.
